symbols.name: DefinitionBinding

modules.summary: Characteristic-state router for configurable context selection.
Scanner and agent-intelligence ports for the characteristic router.

symbols.name: ContentScannerPort
symbols.docstring: Deterministic or host-owned content scanner.

symbols.name: AgentIntelligencePort
symbols.docstring: Optional intelligence hook for OpenClaw, Codex, or other agents. Base form is proposal-only: the deterministic policy remains authoritative unless a host explicitly trusts agent configuration proposals.

symbols.name: KeywordContentScanner
symbols.docstring: Simple deterministic scanner: keyword cues → characteristic states.

symbols.name: AgentIntelligenceAdapter
symbols.docstring: Thin adapter around a callable agent backend (OpenClaw/Codex/etc.). The backend may be any sync callable. Failures become empty proposals so the deterministic router can still decide.

modules.summary: Configurable characteristic-state router contracts. Scan content → observe characteristic states → select a context configuration. Intelligence (OpenClaw/Codex/etc.) plugs in through an optional agent port.

symbols.name: ContentEnvelope
symbols.docstring: Normalized wrapper so any content type can enter the router.

symbols.name: CharacteristicObservation
symbols.docstring: Detected state of one characteristic in the scanned content.

symbols.name: GraphEdge
symbols.docstring: Simple typed relation for neighborhood activation.

symbols.name: CharacteristicGraph
symbols.docstring: Minimal graph substrate: observed nodes + configured edges.

symbols.name: ContextConfiguration
symbols.docstring: Router output: what progressive/packet layers should assemble next.

symbols.name: RouteRule
symbols.docstring: Deterministic mapping from characteristic-state patterns to a configuration.

symbols.name: RoutePolicy
symbols.docstring: Configurable router policy pack for a domain/lens.

symbols.name: RouteState
symbols.docstring: Inspectable router decision.
